en: Ya only learn to appreciate parents after ya leave home. Never give up, Masao.
That girl had a hankerin' for lamb barbecue so bad she damn near starved herself for it. Had me worried for nothin'.
That barbecue girl ran off like the wind. She ain't actually gonna go up the mountain, is she?
From the sound of things at the village, that girl really did head up the mountain!
That barbecue girl actually made it up the mountain. I better take her down to safety.
Made it off the mountain by the skin of our teeth. Hope that girl's gonna be okay.
Gotta hand it to that barbecue girl, she's sure dedicated. Gotta hunt a deer to fill her belly up.
What kinda girl goes that far for a meal? You're something else, Mami Yamashita.
Anti-cold gear, huh? Sounds fishy to me. Wonder if that researcher's still on Tsukasa Street.
So much for the ultimate anti-cold gear! Gotta put this fire out with a fire extinguisher!
That anti-cold gear was some bullshit all right. Still, I guess I don't feel cold anymore.
Some kinda accident outside Northern Lane? Maybe I oughta check it out.
Wasn't expectin' to face off with a bear here in town. Better take care of it before someone gets hurt.
Lucky for me, that bear was pretty small. Nobody ended up gettin' hurt.
Wonder if that little match girl's still out in front of Ambitious.
Hope that match girl's okay. Maybe I'll go look out in front of Ambitious.
Gotta get some nourishin' food to her. Hang in there, little match girl.
The match girl's lookin' much better now. Wish I could help her out with her matches.
I oughta help the poor girl sell some matches. I'll try talkin' to some likely buyers.
So I reminded her of her dad, huh? That's not a bad feeling, I guess.
I should bring that guy behind Don Quijote some hot food.
Good to see him perkin' up. Hope he makes it to Tokyo all right.
Idiots. I'll show 'em how lucky a day they're havin'.
What a touching gesture. Ain't like he needed to give me a gift like that. Hope he's doin' okay in Tokyo.
I'm gonna fall an' eat shit if I try to run. Best to take it easy and make sure I get to the delivery guy.
Gotta deliver this ramen before the noodles get soggy. Wouldn't wanna let that delivery guy down.
That delivery guy sure was dedicated to his job. I feel bad I couldn't help him out.
That delivery guy sure was dedicated to his job. The slippery streets make a hell of an obstacle.
That street performer Inari was in a fix. Guess I could look around the snow sculptures at the snow festival.
Rollin' on big snowballs, huh? I'll go tell that street performer about it.
Glad he liked the idea. I'll go back later to see how he's doin'.
I wandered into a snowball fight by accident. Ah well, I got a pouch now, so I can try it later if I feel like it.
That last email was a little weird, but I have a job to go to now. It's near the taxi stand at Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall.
It was so nice of everyone at Morning Glory to write me letters. I have to do my best to make them proud.
I should go and get that autograph for Horie-san. Castle Records is above the bookstore in Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall.
I got the autograph, so I should bring it to Yamaura-san.
I'm glad I got that autograph handed over safely. I hope both Airi-san and Horie-san feel better soon.
I wonder why there's a crowd on Nakamichi Street. It looks like Yamaura-san is there, too. Maybe I'll ask her.
Yamaura-san was in a duo with Ayu Kurata? Wow! Ayu Kurata was headed to Theater Square. Maybe she's still there.
Ayu Kurata is Yamaura-san's old partner... She headed around back from Theater Square. Maybe now is my chance.
Unfortunately, I'm not ready. Once I'm feeling confident, I'll head around back from Theater Square.
It's a shame, but I don't have what it takes yet. Once I've improved, I'll go around behind Theater Square.
Yamaura-san and Kurata-san kind of get along, don't they? I want to do my best to live up to everyone's expectations.
Maybe I shouldn't have passed on okonomiyaki with the girls from school. I wonder if they're still at Bishamon Bridge.
It was hard to keep up with the conversation, but I can only be myself. Okonomiyaki with Yui might be nice next time.
I turned down that free takoyaki without thinking. Maybe I'll stop by there again sometime.
I hope I did everything right. Genuine takoyaki from a place like that is really delicious!
A free introductory class on voice-related jobs, huh? I might learn something useful for my idol work.
Well, that was very educational. I still can't help but feel bad for taking up their time, though.
Tatsuya-san didn't look very well at all. I should probably help out. I wonder if he's still in Shofukucho.
It's tricky to tell people how good something tastes. I hope I was of as least a little help to Tatsuya-san.
SBR99? It was so sudden, so I turned it down. Maybe Fuyumoto-san is still outside Karaokekan.
I wasn't able to win, but it was really fun livening up the event with others aiming to become pop idols.
It was nice to get the win. I'll have to keep trying my best!
That girl had a pretty grim look on her face. I wonder if she's in show business.
Asuka-chan wants to see an example of stage presence. When I'm ready, I'll go and see her by the river.
It's good to see Asuka-chan getting more confident. Hopefully her next time up on stage goes well.
I got a call from Asuka-chan. What could she want? I'd better hurry to the riverside area where we first met.
I wasn't able to help out. Good luck, Asuka-chan.
It was great to see Asuka-chan doing so well! I guess we're rivals from now on. I can't let her beat me!
That man was a little odd. It sounds like he's looking for gamers.
I wouldn't mind playing that IF8 game again if I get the chance. I did enjoy being a magical girl.
How did this turn into an autograph session all of a sudden? Well, okay, let's do this!
I managed to sign everyone's items. It's really hard getting all the people's names right.
A poster girl audition, huh? I'd better go and ask Yamaura-san about the details.
I'm really nervous about this izakaya audition. I'll go and talk with Yamaura-san once I'm ready.
That was a weird audition. Still, at least it went well.
If I see someone who might be the paparazzo, I'll call Uda-san.
The paparazzo might show up again soon. I should go to Shofukucho.
I feel like I'm being watched. Where's the paparazzo?
I lost sight of the paparazzo. They might show up again, though. I'll go to Shofukucho later.
I found the paparazzo! He was headed to West Shofukucho. I have to go after him!
The paparazzo might show up again soon. I should go to West Shofukucho.
I feel like I'm being watched again. Where could the paparazzo be?
I lost sight of the paparazzo. They might show up again, though. I'll go to West Shofukucho later.
This time the paparazzo is headed to West Sotenbori Street. I'll have to do my best not to lose him!
The paparazzo might show up again soon. I should go to West Sotenbori Street.
I'll track that paparazzo down!
I lost sight of the paparazzo. They might show up again, though. I'll go to West Sotenbori Street later.
The paparazzo got away... I wasn't able to help Uda-san out.
I'm glad I found the paparazzo. I'm glad I could help Uda-san, too!
A dance battle with Ulala-san. This might be inspiring.
Ulala-san is really something. I wonder if I'll come across her on that bridge again sometime.
Were those guys comedians? I saw a guy north of Iwao Bridge looking pretty upset after his friend left him.
I've been invited to give comedy a try. Maybe it would help me with my work.
It's time for the first round of the comedy audition! Haruo-san is waiting for me north of Iwao Bridge.
I wonder if all this comedy practice will pay off. I'll head north of Iwao Bridge if I feel like giving it another shot!
There was a woman in Shofukucho looking for Sky Finance. Perhaps a prospective customer?
Mamagoto Club is in East Shofukucho. Maybe I'll go and take a look.
Murata Trading is in the Shofuku Sotenbori Building on South Shofukucho. Let's see how determined she is.
A real dream comes from a more positive place. Nanako Kodama realizes that now, I think.
I got info on Akihiko Yamori. He's bound to come to Sky Finance. I'll wait for him there.
Where do you think you can borrow money, Yamori-san? You aren't really going to rob a bank, are you?
Yamori-san went into Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall carrying a knife. If I don't stop him quick, he's gonna make the worst mistake of his life!
These guys seem to think I brought Yamori-san here. Sorry, but all you'll be getting from me is a swift beating.
I wouldn't be where I am today if not for Yamori. Still, I really am a softie, aren't I?
I think the office is in a building in West Shofukucho. Let's see if he's ready to lay it all on the line.
He went into that building in West Shofukucho. I think it's time I went for a look.
Well, now I know he means business. The rest is my job. Let's make quick work of this lot!
He's not messing around anymore. I think he'll be fine now.
There was someone near Sky Finance looking for our office. Maybe a new customer?
No wonder his attitude changed so quickly. He's in the same line of work as me.
Now he made off with my wallet! I'll have to catch him and get it back!
That guy was bad news all right. It's always an uphill battle when we open up an office in a new place.
Okay, first I have to meet up with Maya in Ashitaba Park.
Protecting the talent is part of a manager's job. Let's take care of this quick so we can call it a day!
Keep up the good work, Maya-chan. I'll be rooting for you in front of the TV.
I guess shopping in Sotenbori can be a real battle. I wonder if that lady's still at Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall.
Getting a discount is tricky. Things didn't go as planned this time, but at least it was good practice.
That lady was really something else. Still, I'm getting a lot better at this thanks to her.
Haruka-chan has a stalker, huh? I might keep an eye out around her apartment for a while.
So he's the stalker! I'd better catch him.
Hopefully this is the real stalker this time! I've done more than enough running for one day.
What's going on here? I guess I need to calm things down first.
So nobody was stalking Haruka-chan after all. These guys still caused just about as much trouble, though.
Where do these guys get off picking on high school kids? I guess I'll step in and take them on.
Maybe I should have taken that dancer Hide up on his offer.
I had no idea dance battles were this hard. I've got some newfound respect for Haruka-chan.
I wonder if that old lady betting on dance battles is still fleecing youngsters in West Shofukucho.
Ouch, my back still aches. Once it's better, I'll head to West Shofukucho to take on that old lady again.
That was a heated dance battle, all right. Maybe I'll become an idol, too! Hehe.
It isn't right for them to gang up on an old guy. I guess I'll back him up.
So this Ueyama-san is the chairman of Kushikatsu Daruma, huh? I hope he gets some ideas for his new menu.
What'll be good for Kushikatsu Daruma's new menu? Maybe I'll ask the guys at New Serena and see what they think.
Okay, I think I've got the info I need. I should go and report to Ueyama-san on Nakamichi Street.
I hope the input from everyone was useful. I guess I'll go back to Nakamichi Street and check a bit later.
It sounds like the info I gathered was useful for the new menu. Maybe I'll visit Kushikatsu Daruma later.
I can't just ignore Saida-san's plea. He's probably still out in front of the Millennium Tower.
Sheesh, what a pain. I guess I need to talk to Miyu at Elise first.
Where would I study up on fashion? I guess I could go to a convenience store and read the magazines there.
The stuff I read in Leon might help. I'll go tell Saida-san out in front of the Millennium Tower.
Saida-san looked like a new man wearing that GaGa Milano watch. I should go to Elise later and see how things turned out.
Saida-san finally got Miyu to go out with him. Ladies like older bad boys after all, I guess.
Were those two headed to a love hotel? I think there was one at the south end of Shofukucho.
